channel.title: Holistic Life: Small Space Home Gym Ideas
channel.description: Small Space Home Gym Ideas guides from Holistic Life.

item.title: Dumbbell Set for a Small Space: What to Look For in Adjustable Dumbbells
item.description: Looking for adjustable dumbbells for a small space? Check the weight range, the size of each jump, the locking system, the footprint and the return policy before you buy. A simple checklist to save you hassle. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Small Home Gym Gifts: Gear That Folds, Stacks or Hangs
item.description: Small home gym gifts should fold, stack or hang on a wall. This guide covers how to check floors, noise and weight limits, and what to skip, so the gift gets used instead of stored. Guide contains affiliate links.
